name: After Show Hours Radio
author: ravenridgelights-turtle; based on Jason Cross (jcross)
description: Internet radio for FPP 10.4: compact Status controls, named preset pages, manual stream URLs and general music searches. Finds streams at Radio Browser, 181.fm, internet-radio.com, streamurl.link and halloweenradio.net.

privacy.summary: Plays your chosen station and shows it on FPP Status while idle. Searches supported radio directories only when you ask; caches results locally. No telemetry.

sends.to: the radio stream addresses you save or select
sends.what: normal audio requests and small Seek checks
sends.why: play the selected station and skip unreachable stations

sends.what: requests for the selected directory or station page
sends.why: find station names and stream URLs when you use Find stations

sends.what: a request for the public stations page
sends.why: find Halloween station names and stream URLs on request

sends.what: the station name or genre you select or search
sends.why: find names and direct stream URLs in small pages

sends.what: a request for the public legacy stream list
sends.why: find station names and stream URLs on request

sends.what: the station search text, genre and page you choose
sends.why: find station names and published stream URLs on request

systemChanges.what: Adds after-show-hours-radio.service and a private Unix MPD socket; does not modify the packaged MPD service or config.
Adds after-show-hours-radio-pulse.service on FPP PipeWire, plus its isolated config under /etc/after-show-hours-radio/.
Adds after-show-hours-radio-monitor.timer and service, checking playback and the sleep timer about once a minute.

privacy.other: Stations and named preset pages are saved locally under plugindata/After-Show-Hours-Radio. The radio API uses FPP access controls; it adds no public listener. Saved streams may use HTTP. Directory providers and radio stations see your IP and normal request information. Real uninstall removes this plugin data; export a backup first. Reinstall retains settings. No reboot or FPP audio-stack restart is requested. The plugin adds an idle-only radio panel to FPP Status through its menu hook; it does not edit FPP files or replace show status. Radio Browser search text goes only to its API. Version 1.2 updates preserve settings and do not restart audio services or FPPD.
